title: Sample preparation and imaging procedures for super-resolution microscopy using Repeat DNA-PAINT.
protocol: Fix freshly excised porcine cardiac tissue for 1 hour at 4°C in 2% PFA made the previous day in PBS and pH to 7.4.
Move samples to fresh PBS for 10 minutes.
Move samples to 10% sucrose in PBS for 1 hour, 4°C.
Move samples to 20% sucrose in PBS for 1 hour, 4°C.
Move samples to 30% sucrose in PBS overnight at 4°C. Samples should sink.
Remove samples and gently dab with tissue paper to remove excess sucrose solution.
Transfer to cryotubes and label.

Fill a metal dish with 2-Methylbutane and place in thermal insulator containing a shallow quantity of liquid nitrogen. Allow 2-Methylbutane to chill for 3-5 minutes until white precipitates start to form on the metal dish.
Gently place cryotubes into dish, replace lid, and allow 10-15 minutes to freeze.
Carefully remove samples from the dish and store at -20°C or -80°C for long term storage.
Mix 0.5% poly-L-lysine solution and incubate coverslips for 10-15 minutes.
Aspirate off the poly-L-lysine solution from the coverslips.
Take cryosections of tissue and place them onto the pre-treated coverslips.
Attach coverslips to imaging chambers using Pinkysil by mixing small amounts of components A and B equally, applying it to the outskirts of the coverslip, and pressing the chamber down for 5 seconds.
Hydrate the tissue with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 and allow permeabilization for 10 minutes.
Wash the sample with PBS in a standard-size imaging chamber.
Block the sample with PBS containing 10% BSA for 1 hour at room temperature.
Dilute primary antibody to 5 µg/mL in an incubation solution made up of PBS, 1% BSA, 0.05% Triton X-100, and 0.05% sodium azide.
Apply the diluted primary antibody to the sample and leave it overnight at 4°C.
Wash the sample with PBS three to four times for 10-15 minute durations each.
Dilute secondary antibody in incubation solution (1:200).
Apply the diluted secondary antibody to the sample and leave it for 2 hours at room temperature.
Repeat wash step using 600 mM NaCl PBS, pH 8 (PAINT Buffer).
Make two stocks of imaging buffer with an order of magnitude difference in imager concentration.
Use ~0.4 nM ATTO 655 modified strands in PB as the 1x RD imaging buffer.
Use ~40 pM ATTO 655 modified strands in PB as the 10x RD imaging buffer.
Load sample chamber onto microscope stage.
Boot up the connected PC and relevant software packages, including PyME & PyME-extra for data acquisition and analysis.
Replace solution with ~200 µL red bead solution diluted from stock 1:10 k in PB.
Allow 10-15 minutes for beads to settle and stick to tissue and surfaces. Monitor a region closely whilst this is happening to avoid excessive clusters of beads.
Gently wash off excess beads with PB. Check that minimal/no beads are floating through the sample.
Navigate to a region of interest using transmitted light.
View widefield fluorescence of labelled sample using the appropriate dichroic mirror and filters for the dye modified anchor docking strand.
Adjust camera integration time to 100 ms.
Replace buffer with 1x RD imaging buffer containing the imager matching the repeat domain strand (yet to be attached).
Begin acquisition.
Add 0.5 µL of 100 µM 1x RD strand to the ~500 µL sample solution and gently mix.
Allow ~10 minutes for 1x RD strands to fully occupy available anchor docking sites.
Wash off excess, unbound 1x RD strands with 1x RD imaging buffer.
Image for the desired length of time.
Introduce the repeat domain displacer sequence by adding 0.5 µL of 100 µM repeat domain displacer sequence strand to the ~500 µL sample solution and gently mix.
Monitor event rates.
Once event rates have fully decreased, wash off the anchor and displacer strand complexes along with any excess displacer strands using 1x RD buffer.
Wash sample with 10x RD imaging buffer to reduce imager concentration.
Add 0.5 µL of 100 µM 10x RD strand to the ~500 µL sample solution and gently mix.
Give the sample 10-15 minutes for the 10x RD strands to fully attach to the anchor strands.
Wash sample with 10x RD imaging buffer several times to remove excess 10x RD.
Add 0.5 μL of 100 μM 10x RD strand to the ~500 μL sample solution immediately after Step 10 of the labelling procedure section.
Remove excess from solution with successive washes using 10x RD imaging buffer.
